N8's band in N8's place; only colour, cue and phrase change: the solid ◆, text dark on amarillo #F2B705, and in the tray the 22 × 5dp marker bar in --mark-amarillo #F2B705 centred between "tu meta $8" and "tu mínimo $6" (measured 498.5–503.5). The clock stays 14:50, the fixture's amarillo offer; the host's dark theme is its own setting, not the hour.
